families.why: A turn that only answers investigated nothing. It must never block — this is the desensitisation case.

The calibration case: a build/test turn is work, not analysis. Counting every shell call as investigation fires exactly here, which is what the shell classification exists to prevent.
Delegation: an agent was spawned and the wait declared. The result arrives turns later, where the merge is the record — this is the family that decides the Agent trigger (see the core header).
